reflections.summary: Won by trading Rotom-Heat for Pelipper turn 1, immediately dismantling the rain core. Gengar-Mega then OHKO'd Basculegion with Shadow Ball and Shadow Tag trapped Garganacl, preventing switches. Klefki's Thunder Wave on Garganacl proved decisive—full paralysis on turn 5 allowed free damage. Vaporeon finished the 2% Garganacl with rain-boosted Scald. Clean execution with zero decision errors.
reflections.adjustment: Klefki's Foul Play was negligible damage on Garganacl (8-14%); prioritize Thunder Wave and screens support, and pivot Vaporeon in earlier for Helping Hand or Scald pressure rather than relying on Klefki for chip. Also watch for Will-O-Wisp on Gengar—burn cut longevity and nearly cost Gengar before the final KO.
